name: aqspace
description: Repo-level scripts that run the checks of every app (apps/api, apps/worker, apps/web).

scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:worker
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:worker && npm run lint:web
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check:api && npm run format:check:worker && npm run format:check:web
